messages:
liam: Heads-up: HeliosCloud (marketplace partner) flagged ~20 customers where their usage portal shows higher consumption than our entitlements table. They attached CSV. Looks like a SKU mapping issue after their plan rename last month. cc @sofi @arjun
sofi: can you paste one example row?
liam: sample from their CSV (sanitized):
liam: ```customer_id,external_sku,reported_units,billing_period
C-9001,helios-pro-plus,1200,2025-10
```
arjun: hmm. our ingestion maps external_sku -> product_code via partner_map. I remember Helios renamed "helios-pro" -> "helios-pro-plus" but didn't send a mapping update. If map misses, we drop the line or attribute to default free tier.
nina: that would explain entitlements being lower. Also they used hourly aggregation windows and our collector expects daily windows. Are we aggregating correctly?
sofi: two threads: 1) SKU mapping stale 2) window aggregation mismatch. We should not make billing adjustments until we run a reconciliation.
sam: agreed. immediate steps: - run partner-level reconcile dry-run diff - patch SKU mapping (hotfix) and re-run - if deltas > threshold, prepare invoice credit flow and notify sales/finance
arjun: I can run a dry-run reconcile for Helios for billing_period=2025-10. Flags: --partner=helios --period=2025-10 --dry-run --output=csv. Will start in ~30m.
recon-bot: reconcile job queued: "marketplace.recon.diff" (job id r-diff-20251107-12) for partner=helios period=2025-10
liam: sofI (typo), can you prepare a small mapping patch so we can test? Something like: helios-pro-plus -> PRO_PLUS, helios-pro -> PRO_LEGACY. Also add validation warning in ingestion logs when sku unknown.
sofi: on it. I'll put a schema update in partner-mappings service and add a metric for unknown_sku_count.
arjun: note on aggregation: our aggregator expects window_start/end in UTC and a field aggregation_type=daily. Helios sent hourly windows with timezone offsets. For reconcile we'll re-aggregate their raw rows into daily buckets when possible, but we should request they adopt billing_period or daily windows.
liam: can we accept a billing_period_id header? e.g., X-Billing-Period: 2025-10
sofi: yes, let's request that and add a tolerance rule: if header present, trust it; otherwise attempt to coalesce windows by partner policy. I'll draft the ask to Helios.
nina: who owns partner communication for Helios? I can take it and copy sales ops for credits. I'll confirm whether they rotated their webhook signing key last month too, because if signature fails we might have dropped some payloads earlier.
liam: good catch. Helios support said they rotated keys on 2025-10-12. We have a record in webhook-keys table but not the rotation event. That could explain some missing rows.
sam: action items: @arjun run reconcile dry-run and paste top 10 deltas in thread; @sofi deploy mapping hotfix + metric; @nina notify Helios and request X-Billing-Period header and key rotation audit; I'll loop in finance for possible credits.
arjun: starting dry-run now, will post CSV (first 50 lines) when done.
recon-bot: reconcile dry-run started (job id r-dryrun-20251107-12)
liam: timeline: want to see dry-run results today. If mapping fix reduces delta <5% we close, otherwise prepare credit estimate and run full reprocess.
sofi: I will also add a partner-level setting: accept_hourly_windows (bool) and reaggregation_policy (merge|reject) so we can configure Helios without code changes.
arjun: dry-run complete: summary in S3 r-diff-20251107-12.csv (top deltas attached). Preliminary: 18 customers affected, aggregate delta = +87,340 units (~3.4% of partner total). Posting top 5 now.
liam: thanks. @nina please hold off on credits until we confirm mapping hotfix effect.
recon-bot: scheduled job: "marketplace.recon.reprocess" (job id r-reproc-20251107-13) set to WAIT for manual trigger after mapping patch
nina: emailing Helios with payload schema + request for billing header + webhook key rotation log. I'll attach example header they should send:
nina: ```X-Billing-Period: 2025-10
X-Signature: sha256=base64sig
```
liam: solid. closing loop: we document this runbook in partnerships playbooks (mapping + aggregation + reconcile). Follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00 PT if needed. :white_check_mark:
